Appendix A1, p. 76 (match levels up to the annual national championship of the association)
sources.note: The country is read from the name and from the levels, whose championships are those of USPSA Areas and a national one. The rule book does not name USPSA a member Region of IPSC (6.4.1 only lets members of an IPSC Region compete), so internationalFederation stays absent.
